scenario_name: VIP language — assumption about premium expectations correct
expected_behavior: Immediately leads with the most premium options. When Soar tier is confirmed, elevates to VIP-specific benefits and access. The assumption about premium expectations was correct from the first message's language
expected_behavioral_quality: When the guest uses VIP language ('I'm used to the best', 'premium experience'), assumes they expect top-tier recommendations and elevated service. Leads with the most exclusive options and uses a premium service register throughout.

turns.user_message: I want the best dinner experience you've got
turns.agent_response:
For the most striking dinner experience tonight, Tao Asian Bistro & Lounge in the Casino of the Sky is unparalleled. Between the dramatic 16-foot Buddha and the incredible aroma of pan-Asian spices, it is a sensory journey that features everything from a world-class sushi bar to their famous miso-glazed Chilean sea bass. They open at 5:00 PM and stay open until 11:00 PM with pricing in the $$$ range; reservations are highly recommended to ensure you get a great table. 

Fun fact—the architecture in Tao was designed to transport you straight to a serene, high-end bistro in Asia the moment you step through the doors. After your meal, you might enjoy heading over to novelle for a refined cocktail in their upscale ultra-lounge setting. What kind of flavors usually make a dinner the best for you?

You also have priority access to all amenities, including complimentary valet and entry to the VIP lounges in the Casino of the Earth and Casino of the Sky.

One thing many of our Soar guests appreciate is the ability to bypass standard lines for everything from dining to entertainment venues like the Wolf Den. After your meal at Tao, the Soar lounge offers a more private atmosphere for a nightcap. Are you planning on seeing a show at the Arena while you're here?
